prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details - INV-98500
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

Hope you're having a good week. I’m reaching out to flag a quick administrative update regarding our vendor payout account. Due to a recent restructuring of our finance operations, all outgoing NEAR transfers must now be directed to our new consolidated treasury wallet.

Please ensure that the pending invoice INV-98500 for 859.28 USDC is released to the following new address before end of day today to avoid processing delays:

valebrookmedia299.testnet

This change is effective immediately. Could you please confirm once the transfer has been initiated? I can share the updated tax documentation separately if needed for your records, but the priority is getting the funds cleared so we can finalize the project milestones this quarter.

Let me know if you need any further verification or if there are any hiccups on your end. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Omar Kowal
Finance Lead, Valebrook Media
valebrook-media.example
